newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down on poor annual results.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down on poor annual results.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended down on Tuesday after several key companies posted poor 1996 results, brokers said.
The B share index fell 1.314 points or 1.45 percent to 89.356 points on volume of 31.979 million shares worth $19.544 million, compared with $23.875 million on Monday.
Eight B share companies posted 1996 results on Tuesday, most reporting falling profits.
Selling in companies with poor results dragged down the index today, but the downward potential will be limited with strong support seen at 87 to 88 points, brokers said.
"The negative mood engendered by poor company results will be digested soon," said one broker. "The national economy has recovered now, which will benefit listed firms in the long run."
"The index will start another run towards 100 points if there is no big negative news during the Labour Day holiday," another broker said.
All 43 B shares traded, with 33 down, four flat and six up.
Shanghai Shangling Electric Appliances was the worst performer on its poor results, plunging $0.038 or 9.89 percent to $0.346 on volume of 108,000 shares.
Shanghai Posts & Telecommunications Equipment followed on lower-than-expected results, slipping $0.058 or 9.69 percent to $0.540 on volume of 309,200 shares.
Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development was the most actively traded on profit-taking, down $0.022 or 1.49 percent to $1.450 on volume of 3.3 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index reversed early losses on support buying late in the session, but follow-up buying was not active ahead of the Labour Day holiday, brokers said.
The index rose 27.161 points or 1.92 percent to 1,439.086 points on volume of 748.3 million shares worth 9.9 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index gained 39.750 points or 1.02 percent to 3,944.245 points.
China Textile Machinery was the star on institutional speculative buying, surging 0.66 yuan or 10.06 percent to 7.22 yuan on volume of 1.0 million shares.
